Their windows are independent beyond distance k and distinct starts within distance k are incompatible. value.rationale: Cycle cohesion along consecutive labels probes spatial organization not identified by the cycle size counts alone. The all-color result shows a realization-dependent leading logarithmic scale, rules out a deterministic Bernoulli parameter for that scale, and connects the same dominant atom to the quenched lattice threshold. The Dickman transformation makes the scale explicit in the uniform case. The value is in that conclusion for a natural exchangeable cycle statistic, not in repeating a finite enumeration or a fixed-p run theorem.
